This larger-than-life remix of the iconic Suede Classic has been blazing its own path. The Suede XL draws from PUMA's Y2K-inspired styles while retaining classic Suede DNA. But there's a twist. With its extra padding, extra-large tongue, and extra-thick laces, Suede XL maximizes everything. This sneaker is the perfect mix of understated and elevated.
